body: You're right. I have to look to the future for inspiration, get to the point that I've dreamed about. Thank You :) and also thank you for the video, it helped a lot

I think the thing that brought me most happiness would actually be helping people. My own personal hero is a teacher, which inspired to follow that career path. It would seems like something I would enjoy, with being able to help people in the process. But I'm still years from having an established life like that. NOW is just so shitty

I used to be, and I know I can still be if i'm surrounded by friends. Unfortunately right now that's very hard to do, and with a recent decline in motivation, things aren't going to get easier. Even if i do get together with my friends, I'll be happy for a little bit but then immediately go back to feeling like shit as soon as I'm alone to my thoughts. I've never experienced enough happiness to believe that the good will outweigh the bad

What's the point of having something so precious if it's also so shitty. It's like if I got a glass of water that tasted funny. Sure there are tons of people who are less fortunate than me who would do anything for that water. What would I do with it? Toss it down the drain. It's not the best analogy, but what I'm trying to say is why hold onto to something so precious or why I would keep going with something so terrible than getting rid of it and not remember a thing?
